purpose: Pipeline validation only. Not a clinical label, threshold, intervention evaluation, or effectiveness claim.

applies_to: every report, including the sensitivity report
source_marking.storage: Synthetic and real data are never stored in the same tables.

sensitivity_checks: The validation is rerun with weaker (0.7) and stronger (1.3) planted effects as well as nominal (1.0). Report whether the conclusions hold across all three.
ethics: Confirm with the committee that synthetic data without real persons needs no approval. Keep the generator code and this file with the thesis.

plan_deviations.night_time_use_share: model-plan.md lists it as an example feature and label driver (to be confirmed). Omitted because the daily snapshot contract has no time-of-day data.
plan_deviations.pickup_count: model-plan.md lists it as an example feature and label driver (to be confirmed). Replaced by unlock count, which is not a pickup count, and by app launch count as a session proxy.

features.mean_daily_screen_on_seconds: Daily snapshot screen-on total, averaged over the 14-day period.
features.mean_daily_unlock_count: Daily unlock count, averaged over the 14-day period; not a pickup count.
features.mean_daily_launch_count: App launch count, averaged over the 14-day period; used as a session-count proxy.
features.mean_session_seconds: Sum of app foreground seconds divided by app launches.
features.top_app_share: Largest app foreground-time share within the period.
features.weekend_usage_shift: Weekend minus weekday average foreground seconds, divided by overall daily mean.
features.usage_trend_per_day: Least-squares slope of daily foreground seconds over the period.
features.age_band: Synthetic age band; no exact age or registration identifier is generated.
features.declared_interest: Synthetic value from a fixed interest list.

label.name: synthetic_questionnaire_score
label.definition: A noisy 0-100 synthetic proxy based on average daily screen-on hours, daily unlocks, and positive daily foreground-use trend. The binary training label is score >= 50.
label.rule: logit = -3.2 + 0.65 * screen_on_hours + 0.012 * unlocks + 0.7 * max(usage_trend_hours_per_day, 0) + 0.4 * top_app_share + noise
label.noise: Normal noise with standard deviation 0.8 is added to the logit. The inverse logistic transform is multiplied by 100.
label.effect_scale_applied_to: Usage-feature coefficients only; the intercept and noise distribution are unchanged.

excluded: night-time use (not present in the current daily snapshot contract)
pickup count (unlock_count is not a pickup count)
